== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Was born in Milan, Italy to a family of Chinese origin.
* Started playing in Season 3.
* Reached Challenger in Season 7, hitting EU West rank 1 in April 2018.
* Dropped out of high school at age 16 to become a pro player. 
* Plays mid and bot in addition to jungle. 
* Was offered a spot on [[EDward Gaming]] in 2019, but declined due to disliking how hands-on the team was with their players.
* Is often remembered for his accidental {{ci|evelynn}} R into [[micaO]]'s {{ci|ashe}} R during [[MAD Lions]] vs [[INTZ]] in [[Worlds 2020]].<ref>[https://x.com/riotgames/status/1981466003096949127 Riot Games' X Post] ''x.com''</ref>
* Is the younger brother of Chinese streamer [https://liquipedia.net/overwatch/Zhao_Yichen pigff].
* Matched the kill record for [[LPL]] junglers standing at 17, set by [[Karsa]] on {{ci|Viego}} in [[LPL 2022 Spring Playoffs]] vs [[JD Gaming]], with a 17/0/10 {{ci|Naafiri}} game in [[LPL 2025 Split 2 Placements]] vs [[Ninjas in Pyjamas.CN|Ninjas in Pyjamas]]
* First and only European player to win the LPL.

=== Individual Awards ===
* 1x EU 1st All Pro Team (Summer 2020)
